facts.text: To eliminate confusion and create some sense of community identity, the area between Kenner, Harahan, Metairie, and the Mississippi River was officially renamed 'River Ridge' in 1974.
The area was known as Little Farms, a good description of the land and its history.
Jefferson Parish Library operates the River Ridge Branch Library, which held its grand opening ceremony on Friday, May 4, 2018.
In 2019, a baseball team from River Ridge won the Little League World Series, becoming the first team from Louisiana to do so.
The land that is now River Ridge was developed by French colonists for large sugar plantations, whose narrow waterfronts followed a long‑lot layout along the Mississippi.
In the early 20th century, an interurban transit line was constructed through River Ridge to connect New Orleans and Kenner.
